## Peer-reviewed articles

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

library(yaml)

badge_map <- list(
  highly_cited = '<img src="https://drganghe.github.io/files/images/highly-cited-paper-badge.png" title="ESI Highly Cited Paper" alt="Highly cited paper" width="20" />',
  hot_paper = '<img src="https://drganghe.github.io/files/images/hot-paper-badge.png" title="ESI Hot Paper" alt="Hot paper" width="20" />'
)

pubs <- read_yaml("files/data/publications.yml")
pubs <- pubs[order(vapply(pubs, function(x) x$year, numeric(1L)), decreasing = TRUE)]

cat('<div class="pub-list">\n')
for (pub in pubs) {
  doi_url <- sprintf("https://doi.org/%s", pub$doi)
  meta <- sprintf("<em>%s</em>, %s, %s.", pub$journal, pub$volume, pub$pages_or_article)
  badges <- character(0)
  if (!is.null(pub$badges) && length(pub$badges) > 0) {
    badges <- unlist(badge_map[pub$badges], use.names = FALSE)
  }
  badge_suffix <- if (length(badges) > 0) paste0(" ", paste(badges, collapse = " ")) else ""
  author_mark <- if (isTRUE(pub$is_corresponding)) " *" else ""
  metrics <- sprintf(
    '<span class="__dimensions_badge_embed__" data-doi="%s" data-style="large_rectangle"></span> <div data-badge-popover="right" data-badge-type="1" data-doi="%s" data-hide-no-mentions="true" class="altmetric-embed"></div>',
    pub$doi, pub$doi
  )
  entry <- sprintf(
    '<div class="pub-item">%s%s (%s). %s. %s%s<div class="pub-links">[<a href="%s">doi</a>] %s</div></div>\n',
    pub$authors, author_mark, pub$year, pub$title, meta, badge_suffix, doi_url, metrics
  )
  cat(entry)
}
cat("</div>\n")
```
